gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the email address associated with a specific project in Jira so that I can ensure all project communications are directed to the correct email.
gold.ideal: The response should return a JSON object containing the email address for the specified project ID.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to update the email address for a project in Jira to reflect changes in the project team, ensuring that notifications are sent to the right contacts.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful update of the email address for the specified project ID and return the updated email in the response.
